svg.aria-label: Glowback, for Windows: ambient light for the RGB LEDs on the back of your monitor. Every LED follows the picture in front of it, live, or the music the PC plays, with a look per app and a softer light at night. Works with Home Assistant, and through it with Google Assistant, Alexa and Siri. Made with Python, Win32, DXGI, WASAPI and HID LampArray. Free on the Microsoft Store, and open source.
